description: Reads the Strudel code currently playing in the Moontide page, i.e. the last code the page confirmed, including edits the user evaluated by hand; returns 'Nothing is playing yet.' before anything played, with a template of a song structure to start from. Before Moontide is started it says so and starts nothing; after the start its reply also names the page address, the port and the tab title. Call it before every change.
name: get_code
